Catorce temas que van del seno que suena: Fourteen topics going from the sine that sounds to the [[son-taller|whole synthesiser]]. This topic teaches nothing new: it asks. A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block, with a clock and no hints, to find out whether the mathematics of sound, the logarithm of the scale, the Fourier series of timbre, the recurrences of filters and echoes, has stuck.
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock done at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the block's 14 topics, spread across stretches, and each time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submitting, everything is marked, the step-by-step solution to each question opens and the mark comes out by stretch, with links to what is worth revising. The option “tailored to what you have done” puts first what you have not yet solved: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
Periodo, frecuencia y amplitud de un sen: Period, frequency and amplitude of a sine; how many samples a sound has and where the alias falls; from MIDI note to hertz and back; semitones and cents.
Cuánto tarda en apagarse una exponencial: How long an exponential takes to die away; the segments of an ADSR; the amplitude of a harmonic of a sawtooth or a square wave; the modes of a string; the frequency of a bin and the resolution of a spectrum.
Cuántas veces late la suma de dos tonos;: How many times the sum of two tones beats; where the sidebands fall; note or bell in FM; the average of two samples and the one-pole filter, by hand.
El nivel del ruido; afinar y hacer durar: The level of the noise; tuning a Karplus-Strong string and making it last; the height and the sum of the echoes; the teeth of the comb; which beat we are in and which note is due.
Cada tramo aporta un número fijo de preg: Each stretch contributes a fixed number of questions, chosen at random among its topics without repeating a topic while possible, and avoiding the most basic exercises. With 14 topics and 9 questions, a single exam does not touch them all: that is why the link at the end reproduces the same exam, and “another exam” brings out a different one.
Cómo sacarle partido: How to get the most out of it
<strong>Escribe las unidades.</strong> H: Write the units. Hertz, seconds, samples and cents get mixed in the same question, and half the errors in the block are a factor of 1000 or a $1/f$ left uninverted.
For the logarithmic, logarithms. Semitones, cents and decibels are not added or subtracted in hertz: they are ratios. If a question talks of “raising” a note, think of multiplying.
<strong>Las recurrencias, a mano y despa: Recurrences, by hand and slowly. A filter or an echo is solved by writing three or four terms of the sequence: it is what the synthesiser does, sample by sample.
<strong>Lo que falles, tócalo.</strong>: Whatever you get wrong, play it. Each question links to its topic and there the synthesiser can reproduce the formula: hearing a beat or a closed filter teaches more than rereading the definition.
Una pregunta pide la frecuencia de una n: A question asks for the frequency of a note three semitones above 440 Hz and you get 443. What has happened?
Se ha sumado en vez de multiplicar: son: Adding was done instead of multiplying: it is $440\cdot 2^{3/12}$, about 523 Hz
La escala es logarítmica: cada semitono: The scale is logarithmic: each semitone multiplies by $2^{1/12}$. Adding hertz works with beats, not with notes.
Tres hercios de diferencia son un batido: Three hertz of difference is a slow beat, not three semitones. Three semitones is almost 20 % more frequency.
Falta convertir a cents: The conversion to cents is missing
Los cents miden lo mismo con otra escala: Cents measure the same thing on another scale (100 per semitone), but the result asked for is in hertz: what is missing is the power of 2.
El enlace de un examen corregido reprodu: The link to a marked exam reproduces the same questions with the same numbers. A teacher can do one, copy the link and pass it to the class: everyone will sit the same exam and will be able to compare results and procedures.
Elige los tramos que entran. Las pregunt: Choose the stretches to include. The questions are drawn at random from the exercises of each topic in the block, avoiding the most basic ones and without repeating a topic while possible. There are no hints: the marking and the step-by-step solution come on submitting.
Los conservatorios examinaron durante si: Conservatories examined by ear for centuries: dictations of intervals and rhythms to be written on the stave. This block's exam does the same with numbers, how many hertz, how many beats, which pulse, because that is what each topic's synthesiser has been teaching: that behind everything you hear there is a calculation that can be done.
